title: Mega Man 2
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Mega Man still cannot slide, charge or wall-jump. Metal Blade can fire in eight directions and is useful throughout the stages.
E-Tanks are one-use full-health refills. Open the weapon menu before the next hit could kill you. They are not refillable Sub Tanks.

Cleared Robot Master stages cannot be revisited. Item-1, Item-2 and Item-3 are automatic boss rewards, not hidden capsules. The original password resumes before the fortress rather than saving its individual stages.
routeIntro: Metal first gives a useful general weapon. Air comes next for Item-2, which crosses Heat Man’s disappearing-block section. The route has two early Buster fights.

stages.tip: Wait for a gap in the tornado wall. Move underneath him when he jumps; avoid rushing through a closed pattern.

returnIntro: There are no return visits to cleared Robot Master stages. Stock E-Tanks during the initial stages and manage weapon energy through the fortress.
completionText: Clear all Robot Masters, check the utility items listed above, and refill the weapons needed for the final stages.

warning.title: Preserve Crash Bomber and Bubble Lead for the fortress.
warning.text: Boobeam Trap needs Crash Bomber. The final Alien can only be damaged by Bubble Lead. Refill them whenever safe opportunities appear.

sections.title: Wily’s fortress
paragraphs: Stage 1: climb the final ladder using successive Item-1 platforms. Against Mecha Dragon, stay on the high right-hand blocks and use Quick Boomerang.
Stage 2: use Metal Blade or Bubble Lead on the Picopico-kun wall units. Stage 3: hit Guts Tank’s head with Quick Boomerang.
Stage 4: enter Boobeam Trap with full Crash Bomber energy. Destroy only the two walls that directly block targets; use the utility items to reach the others.
After the rematches, use Buster or Crash Bomber on Wily Machine. Refill Bubble Lead before the final descent. The Alien follows a repeating figure-eight; wait for a safe crossing before shooting.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Metal Man is especially vulnerable to his own Metal Blade in the rematch. Leaf Shield protects you on slow-moving platforms.
Time Stopper cannot be cancelled early. Decide whether its energy is more valuable for Quick Man’s beam corridors or his fight.
